segments.caption: At night under bright floodlights, a cyclist races around the perimeter of an empty, fenced-in concrete velodrome or track, with other riders visible in the distance. The camera, likely mounted on a bike, follows the action, capturing the motion of the race on the smooth, marked surface.
At night, under bright floodlights, cyclists race around the velodrome’s banked track, leaning into turns as they compete in a fast-paced cycling event.
Under bright floodlights at night, several cyclists race around the curved, banked track of a velodrome, leaning into the turns as they compete in a fast-paced, illuminated nighttime cycling event.
At night under bright floodlights, a group of cyclists races around a velodrome, leaning into the curves of the banked track as they compete in a fast-paced, high-energy event.

At night on a brightly lit velodrome, players on bicycles compete in a fast-paced game of bike polo, using long sticks to maneuver and strike a small ball while racing around the track. The action is intense and dynamic, with players constantly shifting positions, chasing the ball, and attempting to score goals near the net. The scene captures the high-energy, competitive spirit of the sport under artificial lights, with the "Die Mobiliar" advertising banner visible along the track’s perimeter

At night under bright floodlights, a cyclist wearing a helmet and gloves rides a BMX bike on a velodrome track, using a pole to push off the ground for momentum. Another cyclist in a blue shirt rides nearby, while a third person in a dark shirt is seen bending over their bike in the foreground, suggesting a break or preparation before continuing the ride.
At night under bright floodlights, players on bicycles race around a velodrome, using long poles to maneuver a ball toward the goal, capturing the fast-paced, competitive action of bike polo.
At night under bright floodlights, cyclists race around a velodrome, leaning into turns as they pedal competitively on the banked track.

At night under bright stadium lights, a cyclist wearing a helmet rides a bicycle on a paved track, skillfully maneuvering while holding a long pole, likely playing a game of bike polo. Another player in a purple shirt is visible nearby, and spectators sit on benches along the track’s edge, watching the action unfold.

At night under bright floodlights, players on bicycles compete in a fast-paced game of roll hockey on an outdoor rink, maneuvering with sticks to control the ball while skating around the perimeter marked by advertising banners and surrounded by trees.
At night under bright floodlights, several cyclists ride their bikes around the perimeter of an outdoor velodrome or skate park, navigating the curved concrete surface as they train or ride together.

The camera, mounted on a player’s bike, provides a first-person view as they navigate the curved track, maneuvering around a red goal net and chasing after the ball while competing against other riders.

At night under bright floodlights, a person on a bicycle rides along the edge of an outdoor rink, while another cyclist in a purple shirt rides ahead, both moving along the perimeter. The camera, likely mounted on the rider, captures the scene from a low angle, showing the rink’s surface, a blue line, and spectators seated on benches behind a low wall, with trees and a small building visible in the background.

At night under bright floodlights, a cyclist races around the banked concrete track of an outdoor velodrome, with other riders visible nearby, capturing the fast-paced motion of competitive cycling.

At night, a person rides a scooter or similar vehicle at speed across a concrete skatepark, passing by a hockey goal, fences, and trees, with the camera's motion blur conveying the rapid movement through the dimly lit, enclosed area.
